issues.description: Method mismatch for getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the exercise UML and problem text declare a parameterless method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (see problem_statement.md UML line 70) and the template contains a TODO to implement that method (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java TODO at line 12). The solution implementation instead defines public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75). This difference in the parameter list changes the required signature students must implement and will cause tests or example code that expect the parameterless method to fail or confuse students about the correct contract.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the signature mismatch so all artifacts agree. Recommended options: (A) Restore the parameterless method required by the UML by adding public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() in the solution that returns the total (e.g., numberOfInscribedStudents + numberOfGuestStudents). If the boolean option is desired, add an overloaded method public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) and have the parameterless method call it (or vice versa). Update any internal calls (getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents, getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) to use the parameterless method. (B) Alternatively, if the boolean parameter is intentional, update the problem statement UML and the template TODO to specify getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) so the requirement and template match the solution.
